title: T1659 — Content Injection
subtitle: Watch an upstream content injection unfold step by step.
aria: Animated simulation of content injection: an attacker controlling an upstream traffic box rewrites an HTTP reply, sends the victim to a fake Windows Update page, installs a backdoor, and the SOC detects the download and the beacon.

steps.title: Normal browsing
steps.caption: A victim at an embassy office reads a news site. The office link leaves the building through an upstream transit the attacker controls.
steps.defender: know which links leave your network in plain HTTP.
